versions.content: {DRAFT} If ComM_Nm_UpdateEIRA(<PNC bit vector of EIRA>) is called, then ComM shall transfer the content of the given PNC bit vector to the EIRA of ComM with respect to the PNC bit vector length configured in NmIf.
